name: Classic Red Fedora
description: A wool felt fedora in signature red with a black grosgrain band. Stiff brim, pinched crown and a comfortable inner sweatband for long conference days.

name: Matte Black Coffee Mug
description: A heavy stoneware mug with a matte black glaze. Holds a generous double espresso or a large filter coffee for those long debugging sessions.

name: Red Crew Neck T-Shirt
description: A soft organic cotton crew neck shirt in bright red. Regular fit, preshrunk fabric and reinforced seams that survive many washes.

name: Charcoal Zip Hoodie
description: A brushed fleece hoodie in charcoal with a full length zipper, drawstring hood and two front pockets. Warm enough for chilly data centers.

name: Insulated Water Bottle
description: A double walled stainless steel bottle with a red powder coat finish. Keeps drinks cold for a full day and hot for twelve hours.

name: Commuter Laptop Backpack
description: A water resistant backpack with a padded compartment for laptops up to sixteen inches, quick access pockets and a hidden passport pocket.

name: Developer Sticker Pack
description: Twelve durable vinyl stickers with terminal prompts, curly braces, clouds and geometric shapes. Perfect for decorating laptops and notebooks.

name: Enamel Pin Set
description: Four hard enamel pins with polished metal edges: a fedora, a coffee cup, a cloud and a gear. Comes with locking pin backs.
